name: docling-rs
description: Document conversion for AI agents: PDF with layout, tables, OCR; DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML → Markdown.
long_description: docling.rs, a Rust port of IBM's docling, as an MCP server: it converts PDFs (layout analysis, table structure, OCR), Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, EPUB, e-mail, images, audio and 40-odd other formats to Markdown or docling JSON, and serves MarkItDown's convert_to_markdown tool under the same name and contract. It runs the PyPI launcher with uv (`uvx docling-rs-mcp`), so uv must be installed; local paths are confined to the chosen folder. Office, HTML and e-mail need nothing else; PDFs and scans use ~720 MB of ONNX models, fetched once with `uvx docling-rs-mcp --download-models` (until then PDFs convert from their text layer). PyPI has no macOS wheel, so on a Mac the first start compiles the package (a Rust toolchain is required) — run that command in a terminal first.

tools.name: convert_to_markdown
tools.description: Read a document (URL, file: or data: URI, or path) as Markdown with default settings — MarkItDown's tool of the same name. For other formats or options use convert.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert a document to a chosen format (Markdown, docling JSON, HTML, text, LaTeX, RAG chunks, WebVTT, Pandoc JSON) with options such as page ranges, OCR language or a password.

tools.name: list_input_formats
tools.description: List the file extensions this server converts and whether it accepts http(s) URLs; converts nothing.

root.title: Documents folder
root.description: The folder the server may read documents from; local paths and file: URIs outside it are refused.

allow_url_fetch.title: Fetch URLs
allow_url_fetch.description: Also convert http(s) URLs. Private and loopback addresses stay blocked.

ocr_lang.title: OCR language
ocr_lang.description: The language scans are read in: en, ch, or a BCP-47 tag such as zh-Hans.
